items.title: Proposition 8.12: pushout stability of finite presentation to order n
items.statement_scope: Suppose given a pushout diagram of connective E∞-rings σ: A -> B, A -> A', B -> B'. If f:A -> B is of finite presentation to order n, then f':A' -> B' is of finite presentation to order n. Whole proposition.
items.difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: the proposition proves pushout stability of finite presentation to order n by identifying π0B' with Tor_0^{π0A}(π0B,π0A') and by showing B'⊗_B L_{B/A} is perfect to order n (statement and proof page 42). A genuine technical descent step above routine checking.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Pushout stability of finite presentation to order n for connective E∞-rings, via Tor_0 and relative cotangent complex perfectness.
